crossRefs.note: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

people.name: Enosh
people.line: Son of Seth, during whose time people called on the Lord's name.

translations.web: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
translations.bsb: So Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
translations.kjv: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
translations.asv: and all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
